dedupe_keys.name: acma licensed broadcasting transmitter data am fm tv and digital radio data gov au

description: This ACMA dataset lists licensed broadcasting transmitters operating in the broadcast services bands in Australia: AM radio, FM radio, analogue TV, digital TV, digital radio, and temporary services for special events, test transmissions and temporary community broadcasting licences. It is offered as a Google Earth KMZ of transmitter maps, a Microsoft Access database and an Excel workbook, and the ACMA transmitter list gives station call sign, licence number, channel or frequency and service area. The data.gov.au page shows it created on 12 May 2013 and updated on 2 January 2026, with geospatial coverage of Australia. Producer: Australian Communications and Media Authority, published on data.gov.au. Coverage: Australia. Access: free download from the data.gov.au dataset page; the page was read, the files were not opened. Licence and cost: free under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia. Caveats: the column list and record count were not checked, and the ACMA site itself did not answer through the proxy. Simulation uses: the transmitter inventory supports coverage, siting and network-flow models of broadcast delivery and resilience studies. Related records: the FCC LMS and CDBS broadcast station databases (data-fcc-lms-cdbs-broadcast-station-databases) and Ofcom broadcast transmitter parameters (data-ofcom-broadcast-transmitter-parameters).
